method.source: GitHub forbidden-strings workflow runs filtered event=push, branch=main, created in seven complete UTC days
method.timestampMeaning: workflow created_at, a proxy for push arrival; not git author/committer time or a push-event timestamp
method.deltaMeaning: git diff --name-only --no-renames between consecutive observed push heads, including deletions
method.eventMeaning: one workflow run per observed push; reruns retained as run_attempt, not multiplied into new pushes
limitations: Deleted or never-created workflow runs cannot be recovered by this endpoint; completeness is relative to returned workflow history.
Consecutive heads reconstruct observed tree transitions, not signed push webhook before/after payloads.
A push can introduce several commits; commit count is not push count.
Reverse consumers use current manifests at snapshotCommit, include declared dev/peer/optional dependencies, and miss undeclared imports or historical renames.
Affected group mapping is an explicit proposed conservative selector, not a record that these tests ran.
No requested-week music-player workflow jobs exist; zero union denotes absent observed workflow coverage, not zero testing need or free future execution.

selector.sharedAudio: core changes select desktop and Android; application integration changes also select core tests
selector.rootInputs: root tool inputs select all measured ecosystems; root TypeScript/config/task utility inputs select logger/browser and other packages
selector.docs: doc/, skill directories, named package/root documentation, and license paths are documentation-classified; other paths remain test candidates

currentRequiredChecks.observation: API returned no required status-check contexts; current branch rules list Copilot review on push. This does not establish historical settings.
